name: Corneille de Lyon

summary.text: Corneille de Lyon was a Dutch painter of portraits who was active in Lyon, France, from 1533 until his death. In France and the Netherlands he is also still known as Corneille de La Haye after his birthplace, The Hague.

21512939: Portrait of an Unknown Gentleman or Man in a Black Beret Holding a Pair of Gloves is a 1530s oil on panel painting by the French artist Corneille de Lyon. Formerly in the collection of Robin Benson, it is now in the Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon, which bought it in 2014.
Portrait of an Unknown Gentleman (Corneille de Lyon)
21693141: Portrait of a Lady is an oil on panel painting by Corneille de Lyon, from c. 1533-1536. It is known in three versions.
